name: Water sapphire
description: A magical gemstone Drufalden used to freeze land.

timeline.summary: Drufalden uses a water sapphire to freeze a large section of land, creating the Silver Sea.
timeline.quote: she was able to draw enough strength to freeze a large section of land

citation.text: "Drufalden", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drufalden loses her water sapphire while swimming in a stream; it ends up in the River Kingdom.
timeline.quote: she lost her water sapphire while swimming in a stream

citation.text: "Drufalden", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 3050 AR Ogwater Rifkin receives the stone from the king of the selkies and casts a song spell melting the ice of Drufalden's realm.
timeline.quote: Ogwater used the gemstone to cast a great song spell to melt the ice of the Rigida's queendom.
